label: Quectel RM520N-GL 5G sub-6 M.2 module
description: 5G sub-6 GHz M.2 Key B module (30 x 52 x 2.3 mm, Snapdragon X62, 3GPP Rel.16, no mmWave) at 2.4 Gbps down / 900 Mbps up in SA and 3.4 Gbps / 550 Mbps in NSA. It has no Ethernet of its own - the host data path is modelled as wan5g and a carrier board is needed to wire it into a lab.
